standouts.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

standouts.head: Strong uptrend (ADX 42)
standouts.text: Trend strength (ADX) reads 42, above the 25 that marks a strong trend, with buyers in control of the directional lines.
standouts.learn: A 0-100 gauge of trend strength, not direction; above 25 is a strong trend.

standouts.head: 1 of the desk's strategy kind buying
standouts.text: The desk's own strategies signaled a buy: 1 kind of strategy.
standouts.learn: The desk's own trading rules; when several kinds agree on a name, the read counts it.

material.head: Downtrend on every average
material.text: Price is below its falling 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is below the 200-day.
material.learn: Both averages falling with price under them: the long trend points down.

material.head: Weekly chart: declining
material.text: Price is below a falling 30-week average: the declining stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A lower high and a lower low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
material.learn: Falling swing highs and lows are the steps of a downtrend.

material.head: Support −11% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −11% below (1.3 ATR), where 5 levels (4 kinds) meet: the most-traded price of six months, the average price paid since the Oct 26 low and the 61.8% retracement of the Oct 26–Nov 5 rise.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Heavy buying on Nov 5
material.text: On Nov 5 it moved +17% on 2.9x its average volume.
material.learn: A session's volume against its 50-day average; big moves on heavy volume carry more weight.

standouts.head: Heavy buying on the rise
standouts.text: Volume on the current rise runs 27% above its 50-day average.
standouts.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

against.head: Bounce in a downtrend
against.text: Price has bounced above its 50-day average but stays under the falling 200-day, with the 50-day below the 200-day.
against.learn: A rise inside a downtrend; sellers often return at resistance.

against.head: Recovered 37% of its one-year fall
against.text: The fall ran Nov 13, 2025 to Jun 26; price is inside the 23.6–38.2% band.
against.learn: Pullbacks often stop near 38%, 50% or 62% of the move before; past 62% the move itself is in doubt.

material.head: A breakaway gap up
material.text: On Nov 4 it gapped up out of a tight range on 2.6x volume and has held (+3.3% at the open).
material.learn: A gap out of a range on heavy volume that holds: the start of a move.

material.head: Downtrend broken: over its last swing high
material.text: The swings had been falling, but price has closed over the last swing high (Oct 9): the run of lower highs is broken.
material.learn: A downtrend's first crack: a close over its latest lower high.

material.head: Reclaimed its 50-day average

material.head: Weekly chart: basing
material.text: The 30-week average is flat: a base, with price on its top side.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.
